patch.value: Sanitize Node test-runner context before release verification

pm-ops verify-release inherits NODE_TEST_CONTEXT when invoked from node:test. Downstream release:check commands then believe they are recursively running under the parent test runner, skip their test files, and fail or produce misleading results.
A regression test proves NODE_TEST_CONTEXT is absent from spawned release checks; The live pm-csv verify-release workflow executes its downstream tests without the recursive node:test warning
pm-ops 2026.7.29-1 under Node.js 24; real-data acceptance against pm-csv
Run the opt-in real-data pm-ops acceptance test with PM_OPS_TEST_REPOS including pm-csv; verify-release invokes npm run release:check while NODE_TEST_CONTEXT is present.
Each downstream release check runs in a clean process environment and executes its complete test suite.
Node emits a recursive node:test warning, skips test files, and the downstream coverage gate reports that no LCOV report was written.
Repository readiness checks can fail spuriously or omit tests when pm-ops is exercised from a Node test harness.
